component.name: gcal-client
component.summary: Several Google accounts' calendars in one view

description.p: A native desktop client for Google Calendar that shows the calendars of several Google accounts, for example a personal and a work one, in one view. It follows the web interface in its views and keyboard shortcuts.
It talks to Google and to nothing else: no statistics, no crash reports, no update checks. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
